templates.title: Battery Charge Management
templates.description: Optimize battery discharge to support peak demand while respecting configured reserve, manufacturer recommendation, and organizational floor.
triggers: Site deficit > 3 MW persists for 5 minutes
AND battery SOC > 60% before discharge starts
Block unsafe execution or stale battery telemetry

activity: Baseline dispatch 6 MW supporting 44 MW demand

templates.description: Recommend grid import when demand exceeds available generation and battery supply.

rules: Proposed import: 8 MW for 15 minutes (2 MWh)
Modified 6 MW import leaves a 2 MW deficit
Execution requires verified control permission and fresh telemetry
